output_list.criticism: The function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is added to the stakes mapping without a check, which could lead to a very large amount being staked, in the event an attacker succeeds in calling the stake function.

The function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is subtracted from the stakes mapping without a check, which could lead to a very large amount being unstaked, in the event an attacker succeeds in calling the unstake function.

The function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The reward is added to the rewards mapping without a check, which could lead to a very large amount being rewarded, in the event an attacker succeeds in calling the getReward function.
